context: Colleagues plan an after-work food gathering
purpose: Teach: 風邪薬/セット/お湯/飲み物/食事会/カウンター/注文する/大盛り

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来週の食事会、もう店は決まりましたか？
lines.en: Have you decided on a place for next week's dinner gathering?
lines.style: Polite colleague tone, opening a planning conversation casually.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 駅前の居酒屋を考えています。カウンター席なら予約なしでも入れそうです。
lines.en: I'm thinking of the izakaya near the station. We can probably get counter seats without a reservation.
lines.style: Soft-spoken female office worker, thoughtful and practical suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいですね。あそこは飲み物の種類も多いし、料理を注文するのも簡単ですよ。
lines.en: Sounds good. That place has lots of drink options and ordering food is easy.
lines.style: Agreeable male coworker, sharing positive past experience enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 田中さんは大盛りが好きだから、ご飯多めのセットを頼むといいかも。
lines.en: Tanaka likes large portions, so maybe we should order the set with extra rice.
lines.style: Friendly considerate suggestion, thinking of a coworker's preferences.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、そういえば田中さん、今朝ちょっと寒そうにしてましたね。風邪薬持ってるかな。
lines.en: Oh, come to think of it, Tanaka seemed a bit cold this morning. I wonder if he has cold medicine.
lines.style: Concerned coworker shifting topic naturally with worry.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 後でお湯と一緒に渡しておきます。温かいものを飲んだほうがいいですから。
lines.en: I'll bring him some with hot water later. It's better to drink something warm.
lines.style: Caring female colleague, offering practical help with quiet kindness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: さすが優しいですね。じゃあ食事会は金曜の七時で予約お願いします。
lines.en: That's so kind of you. Then please book the dinner for seven on Friday.
lines.style: Appreciative male voice wrapping up planning with warm gratitude.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解です。みんなにメッセージで知らせておきますね。
lines.en: Got it. I'll let everyone know by message.
lines.style: Efficient cheerful closing line, confirming follow-up action briefly.
